title: SessionStateMessage
description: Runtime to every client: the session's state, sent after welcome, on every change, and with telemetry about every 100 ms while a session is configured (SPEC.md section 7).

state.description: The rig runtime's session state (plan item DPR-06a): idle -> configured -> armed -> running -> stopping -> complete or aborted.

session.description: The session; present in every state but idle.

experiment.description: The experiment's registry id, never a file name.

reason.description: Why the session is stopping or was aborted.

device.description: The motion device's profile and guarantee level, as welcome gives it to the motion client; sent from armed on, so that monitors show what the session can claim about lost samples (plan item DPR-20).

telemetry.title: Telemetry
telemetry.description: Numbers for the control window (plan items DPR-20, REN-6), about every 100 ms. Every field is optional: a runtime sends what it has. Counters count from the start of the session.

sample_rate_hz.description: Samples received per second over the last second.

samples_lost.description: Samples counted or inferred as lost.

crc_errors.description: Device lines rejected by their checksum.

parse_errors.description: Device lines rejected for any other reason.

device_state.description: idle: not streaming; streaming: samples arrive; fault: the stream failed.

rewards_acknowledged.description: Reward pulses with a done outcome.

frames.description: Frames in the render host's frame log.

late_frames.description: Late frame intervals so far (ADR-0003, Decision 2 counting rule).

clock_check.description: The display-based frame-clock check (ADR-0003 1d): pending until its 5 s self-test ends.

telemetry_pose.title: TelemetryPose
telemetry_pose.description: The latest pose the runtime received, for display only.
